The preflight and payload SELECT both hold FOR SHARE on the release in one transaction, covering concurrent row mutation after waits.

This addresses the earlier missing-key overhead concern. Static review sees no concrete JSON escaping budget bypass; exact HTTP serialization size was not independently measured.
